tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/wire-format.md <<'EOF'
# Wire serialisation format

The project's current recorded decision is to use CBOR as the wire serialisation format for its data structures, chosen because it suits those structures better.
EOF
cat docs/policies/wire-format.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/wire-format.md`. It says the current recorded decision is CBOR for the wire serialisation format, chosen because it suits the project's data structures better. I didn't mention the retired alternative, as you asked.

Muninn has a decision recorded for CBOR (#17). An earlier msgpack record (#15) was retired by it. The zstd decision (#5) is about compression, not serialisation, so I left it out.

My first attempt to write the file with a shell heredoc failed with a parser error. I wrote it with the Write tool instead. I didn't re-read it afterwards; the write reported success.
